welcome.title: Welcome to CharacterVault
welcome.subtitle: Character cards and lorebooks, in the browser
welcome.description: CharacterVault is your workspace for SillyTavern-compatible V2 and V3 character cards and World Info lorebooks. Cards and books are stored locally in your browser. No account is required for core use.

one.label: Your vault
one.detail: Two libraries on the home screen (Characters and Lorebooks) with search by name or tags

two.label: Tabbed editor
two.detail: Dedicated tabs for every card field, with auto-save as you type

three.label: AI when you want it
three.detail: Toolbar, Orion chat, and an Agent that can write the open card or book, after you add a provider in Settings

vault.title: Your vault
vault.subtitle: Characters, lorebooks, and ways to start
vault.description: The home screen has a Characters tab and a Lorebooks tab. Search, import existing files, create a blank item, or generate a card with AI Create. You can also drag and drop files onto the vault.

one.label: Import
one.detail: PNG cards with embedded data, character JSON, or lorebook JSON. Multiple files and drag-and-drop are supported

two.label: New / AI Create
two.detail: Start from a blank template, or open AI Creation Studio from the header to generate a card from a concept or tags

three.label: Backup
three.detail: Download a ZIP of your characters and lorebooks from the vault header

four.label: SillyTavern extension
four.detail: Install the companion extension and export choosing “CharacterVault” to send cards here

editor.title: Edit in sections
editor.subtitle: Every field has its own tab
editor.description: Open a character to enter the workspace. Tabs cover name, description, personality, scenario, greetings, examples, system prompt, lorebook, and more. Changes save automatically. Each text section uses a focused editor with search and replace.

one.label: Core fields
one.detail: Name, Description, Personality, Scenario, First Message, Greetings, Examples, System Prompt, and the rest of the spec

two.label: Image
two.detail: Upload or replace the portrait on the Image tab

three.label: Card lorebook
three.detail: Manage World Info entries on the card (keys, priority, position, and content) with the same editor used for vault books

ai.title: Three AI tools
ai.subtitle: Configure a provider, then pick the tool
ai.description: Open Settings (gear in the workspace) and add a provider under AI Config. After that you have three tools: an inline toolbar, Orion for chat, and an Agent that can edit the open character or lorebook.

one.label: Toolbar
one.detail: Select text in the editor to enhance, rephrase, shorten, lengthen, fix grammar, or run a custom instruction. Streamed results can be accepted or rejected

two.label: Orion
two.detail: Open the Ask AI panel to brainstorm and draft in chat. Pin card sections in AI Context. Orion does not change the card unless you copy from it

three.label: Agent
three.detail: Toggle Agent in the Ask AI header. It reads and writes the open character or lorebook. Changes land when the run finishes; a snapshot is taken first

lorebook.title: Lorebook vault
lorebook.subtitle: Standalone World Info, linked if you want
lorebook.description: The Lorebooks tab is a second library for standalone World Info books, each with its own workspace. You can link one book to many characters so edits stay in sync. Card export still uses the lorebook stored on the card.

one.label: Library
one.detail: Create, import, export, and duplicate standalone lorebooks from the Lorebooks tab

two.label: Link to characters
two.detail: Open in vault from a character to attach a library book. Edits in the lorebook workspace update every linked character

three.label: Recursion map
three.detail: Open Map in the lorebook editor to see unlock paths between entries

snapshots.title: Snapshots and export
snapshots.subtitle: Roll back, then ship
snapshots.description: Use History in the workspace to save snapshots and restore a full card, individual sections, or a standalone lorebook. When you are ready, export a single card or back up the whole vault.

one.label: Snapshots
one.detail: Save a point in time and roll back later: full card, selected sections, or the open lorebook

two.label: Export
two.detail: Save a PNG with embedded card data, or the raw JSON. Lorebooks export as JSON

three.label: Backup
three.detail: From the vault header, download a ZIP of characters and lorebooks

ready.title: You're all set!
ready.subtitle: Start building
ready.description: That's the orientation. Replay this walkthrough anytime with the help icon in the header, or open the docs from the book icon. Cards and lorebooks stay in your browser. Optional AI calls go to the provider you configure.

one.label: Get started
one.detail: Create a character, import a card, or use AI Create

two.label: Replay tutorial
two.detail: Click the help icon (?) in the header bar anytime

three.label: Your data
three.detail: Cards and lorebooks stay local. No sign-up for core use. AI is optional and uses your provider
